# RFC 2578 section 7.7 fixes the shape of a conceptual table: the table
# object's SYNTAX is SEQUENCE OF a row type, the row is its only child,
# and every column is a child of the row. That is why the shape below is
# read off the OID tree rather than off the SEQUENCE type's spelling.
#
# The same section says the row's INDEX names the objects that identify a
# row, that IMPLIED may qualify only the last of them, and that AUGMENTS
# stands in place of an INDEX for a row that extends another one
# one-for-one.

dialect TEST-TABLE-MIB SMIv2

oid  TEST-TABLE-MIB.portTable 1.3.6.1.4.1.47003.1
kind TEST-TABLE-MIB.portTable table
oid  TEST-TABLE-MIB.portEntry 1.3.6.1.4.1.47003.1.1
kind TEST-TABLE-MIB.portEntry row

table-row     TEST-TABLE-MIB.portTable portEntry
table-columns TEST-TABLE-MIB.portTable portIndex portName portStatus
table-index   TEST-TABLE-MIB.portTable portIndex

# A column carries the access its own declaration gave it, and an index
# column that is not-accessible stays in the column list: it is part of
# the row whether or not an agent will return it.
oid    TEST-TABLE-MIB.portIndex 1.3.6.1.4.1.47003.1.1.1
kind   TEST-TABLE-MIB.portIndex column
access TEST-TABLE-MIB.portIndex not-accessible
syntax-ranges TEST-TABLE-MIB.portIndex 1..2147483647

oid          TEST-TABLE-MIB.portName 1.3.6.1.4.1.47003.1.1.2
kind         TEST-TABLE-MIB.portName column
access       TEST-TABLE-MIB.portName read-only
syntax-sizes TEST-TABLE-MIB.portName 0..64

oid            TEST-TABLE-MIB.portStatus 1.3.6.1.4.1.47003.1.1.3
syntax-members TEST-TABLE-MIB.portStatus up(1) down(2)

# An augmenting row has no INDEX of its own: its index is the base row's,
# which is what AUGMENTS says and what leaves the index list empty here.
oid             TEST-TABLE-MIB.portXTable 1.3.6.1.4.1.47003.2
oid             TEST-TABLE-MIB.portXEntry 1.3.6.1.4.1.47003.2.1
augments        TEST-TABLE-MIB.portXEntry portEntry
index           TEST-TABLE-MIB.portXEntry (none)
table-row       TEST-TABLE-MIB.portXTable portXEntry
table-columns   TEST-TABLE-MIB.portXTable portXAlias
table-augments  TEST-TABLE-MIB.portXTable portEntry
oid             TEST-TABLE-MIB.portXAlias 1.3.6.1.4.1.47003.2.1.1

# IMPLIED is kept where the source wrote it, on the last index part, and
# is not folded into the name.
oid           TEST-TABLE-MIB.sessionTable 1.3.6.1.4.1.47003.3
oid           TEST-TABLE-MIB.sessionEntry 1.3.6.1.4.1.47003.3.1
index         TEST-TABLE-MIB.sessionEntry sessionAddr IMPLIED sessionName
table-index   TEST-TABLE-MIB.sessionTable sessionAddr IMPLIED sessionName
table-columns TEST-TABLE-MIB.sessionTable sessionAddr sessionName sessionState
oid           TEST-TABLE-MIB.sessionAddr 1.3.6.1.4.1.47003.3.1.1
syntax-base   TEST-TABLE-MIB.sessionAddr IpAddress
oid           TEST-TABLE-MIB.sessionName 1.3.6.1.4.1.47003.3.1.2
syntax-sizes  TEST-TABLE-MIB.sessionName 1..32
oid           TEST-TABLE-MIB.sessionState 1.3.6.1.4.1.47003.3.1.3
access        TEST-TABLE-MIB.sessionState read-only
